summary: Verified all Paper Trading enhancements - Backend APIs (17/18 tests passed) and Frontend UI (all features working). New features: continuous mode, graceful stop, cumulative stats, AI learning integration, navigation order all functioning correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/paper/status returns correct structure (running, message when no session)
GET /api/paper/cumulative-stats returns overall, by_strategy (all 4 strategies), by_asset_class, current_session_included
GET /api/paper/ai-stats returns ai_stats with session_learning and signal_usage fields
POST /api/paper/start accepts continuous_mode=true parameter and returns continuous_mode in response
POST /api/paper/stop accepts graceful=true parameter for graceful shutdown
Navigation order correct: Dashboard → Config → Markets → Positions → Analytics → Backtest → Paper Trade → Tuning
Paper Trading page has 5 tabs: Live Session, Cumulative Stats, Sessions, Strategy Optimizer, RL Learning
Cumulative Stats tab shows Strategy Performance table with all 4 strategies (Delta-Neutral, Volatility, Alpha, Arbitrage)
Single/Continuous toggle button visible and clickable - switches between modes
RL Learning tab shows Session Learning Progress and AI Signal Integration sections
Backend paper_trader loads user config from database via _load_user_config()
Learning loop runs every 30 seconds in continuous mode vs 60 seconds in single mode (line 652)
